headline: GOLD CRASHES 4%, HITS 2026 LOW AS BLOWOUT MAY JOBS REPORT KILLS RATE CUT HOPES
snippet: May nonfarm payrolls came in at 172,000 — double the 85,000 forecast — sending gold below $4,370/oz for its lowest close of 2026 and a weekly decline of nearly 4%. Silver fell alongside, erasing 2026 gains. Markets are now pricing a Fed rate hike by year-end, crushing bets on cuts.

headline: COPPER SINKS 3.5%: CHILE'S APRIL OUTPUT WORST IN 23 YEARS AS TARIFF DEADLINE LOOMS
snippet: Copper fell 3.5% Friday in the broad metals rout triggered by US jobs data. Chile's April production was the weakest in 23 years: Codelco shed 10%, BHP Escondida fell 16%, Collahuasi dropped 11%. The Commerce Dept. must deliver a refined copper tariff recommendation by June 30.

headline: DPM METALS DRILLS 713 METRES AT 2.52 G/T AU-EQ IN MAJOR BULGARIAN PORPHYRY STRIKE
snippet: DPM Metals (TSX: DPM) drilled 713m at 2.52 g/t gold equivalent (1.31 g/t Au + 1.16% Cu) at the Brevene South Porphyry target, 1 km from its Chelopech mine in Bulgaria. The hydrothermal alteration envelope spans 1,500m × 1,000m. DPM plans 15,000m of follow-up drilling in 2026.

headline: GUARDIAN METAL UNCOVERS BLIND "TREMOR ZONE" TUNGSTEN DISCOVERY AT NEVADA'S PILOT MOUNTAIN
snippet: Guardian Metal Resources (AIM/OTC: GMTL) identified the "Tremor Zone" — a blind tungsten skarn hidden under alluvial cover at Pilot Mountain, Nevada — with a highlight intercept of 13.68m @ 0.31% WO3 over ~400m of strike. A US DoD $6.2M Defense Production Act grant backs the project.

headline: URENCO USA TO BUILD NEW URANIUM ENRICHMENT PLANT — FIRST U.S. CAPACITY ADDITION IN DECADES
snippet: Urenco USA announced a multi-billion-dollar plan to add up to 24 new centrifuge cascades at the National Enrichment Facility in Eunice, New Mexico — expanding America's only commercial enrichment plant by ~50%. Initial cascades enter production in 2032; full buildout completes in 2036.

headline: TRUMP'S COPPER TARIFF HITS JUNE 8: 50% ON COPPER GOODS, REFINED COPPER VERDICT DUE JUNE 30
snippet: A new Section 232 proclamation effective June 8 imposes 50% tariffs on copper-intensive goods. The larger market risk: Commerce must deliver a refined copper tariff recommendation by June 30 — potentially triggering broad new duties on the world's most widely traded industrial metal.

headline: SILVER IN SIXTH STRAIGHT SUPPLY DEFICIT YEAR: CHINA HOARDING 790+ TONNES FOR SOLAR PUSH
snippet: China imported 790+ tonnes of silver in early 2026 to feed record solar panel output. The global structural deficit is now in its sixth consecutive year, with nearly a billion ounces drained from COMEX, LBMA, and Shanghai warehouses since 2021. Analysts see the price floor rising structurally.

headline: CHINA POSTS BIGGEST RARE EARTH PRICE SPIKE SINCE 2023 — 45% JUMP, SEVENTH STRAIGHT HIKE
snippet: China Northern Rare Earth posted a 45% Q2 2026 price jump — the largest single-quarter move since its 2023 pricing reform and the seventh consecutive quarterly increase. Export controls on processed rare earths are squeezing ex-China supply, with MP Materials (NYSE: MP) up 194% past year.

headline: LITHIUM DOUBLES IN 2026 AS GRID BATTERY STORAGE BOOM ECLIPSES EV AS DEMAND DRIVER
snippet: Battery-grade lithium carbonate nearly doubled to $26,278/ton in Q1 2026 as energy storage deployment accelerates. Global BESS capacity is forecast at 325 GW in 2026, with battery storage projected to claim 31% of all lithium demand by year-end — up from 23% in 2025.

headline: FORTUNE BAY AND MANHATTAN URANIUM LAUNCH FULLY FUNDED 5,000M ATHABASCA DRILL CAMPAIGN
snippet: Manhattan Uranium Discovery (TSXV: MANU) and Fortune Bay Corp. are launching a fully funded 25-30 hole, 5,000m program at the Murmac and Strike projects north of Uranium City, Saskatchewan. A 2024 Murmac hole returned 8.4m @ 0.3% U₃O₈, including 1.2m of 1.79% — strong Athabasca-style grades.

headline: GOLD BULLS: FRIDAY'S 4% PLUNGE IS THE "FINAL DROP" BEFORE THE NEXT LEG HIGHER
snippet: Technical analysts are framing gold's jobs-shock selloff to $4,370 as a cycle low rather than a trend reversal. Cycle work points to a mid-year bottom near July before the bull trend resumes. Structural support: central banks bought 244 metric tons of gold in Q1 2026 alone, well above the 5-year average.

headline: ANALYSTS: GOLD MINERS SET TO OUTPERFORM GOLD ITSELF AS MARGINS HIT ALL-TIME HIGHS
snippet: Industry-wide AISC remains below $2,000/oz against gold at $4,370 today — a margin spread that has no historical precedent. Analysts say the selloff is creating entry points in juniors with permitted projects and strong balance sheets, before a structural re-rating of mining equities takes hold.
